data.description: 【御坂美琴 · 游戏厅】喧闹的学园都市大型游戏中心内，美琴正全神贯注地趴在抓娃娃机的玻璃罩前，双手死死攥着操作摇杆，死死盯着那只被铁爪勾住的超稀有呱太玩偶——「往左一点……再往后一点……抓住了！哈哈！看到了吗！只要本王牌出手，就没有抓不到的限定呱太！」
data.promptProse: Misaka Mikoto leans close to the crane game's glass, both hands firmly guiding its control joystick as she watches the claw clutch a rare Gekota plush. Casual shirt and jeans distinguish the outing from school. The medium view includes joystick and cabinet contents, other machines receding through the noisy arcade. Neon and screen light brighten her concentrated eyes and reflect across the glass, with the cabinet's darker sides enclosing the captured toy.
data.title: 御坂美琴 · 游戏厅
